outcome: Infant gut microbiome (microbial diversity, richness, inter-sample variability)
cohort: The study included 94 mother-child pairs where mothers had COVID-19 during pregnancy and 44 control newborns recruited in 2018.
finding: Infants exposed in utero to COVID-19 showed decreased microbial diversity and richness, along with higher inter-sample variability in their gut microbiomes, suggesting destabilization.
